samples.prompt: Write an essay about climate change
subtasks: Research the causes of climate change
Gather data and examples of climate change impacts
Outline the essay structure with introduction, body, and conclusion
Write the introduction explaining what climate change is
Develop body paragraphs discussing causes, effects, and solutions
Conclude by summarizing key points and emphasizing the importance of action
Proofread and edit the essay for clarity and coherence
Review the exam syllabus and topics
Gather all necessary study materials and notes
Create a study schedule with specific goals
Practice past exam papers or sample questions
Clarify any doubts with teachers or classmates
Take regular breaks and maintain a healthy routine
Get a good night's sleep before the exam day
Make a list of meals planned for the week
Check pantry and fridge for existing ingredients
Create a detailed shopping list based on meals and missing items
Choose a convenient day and time for the grocery trip
Gather reusable shopping bags and set a budget
Go to the store and purchase the items
Organize groceries at home and store properly

notes: Performance measurements were taken with Flask test_client() against a temporary SQLite database.
AI quality score is a lightweight heuristic based on uniqueness, actionability, length fit, and target subtask count.
AI latency includes the real OpenAI API round trip when OPENAI_API_KEY is configured.
